<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 132.3pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><I>Mingsheng Chen &ndash;
Agreement on Assignment of Claims</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 31.05pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#29616;&#26377;&#21407;&#20538;&#26435;&#20154;
<U>&#38472;&#26126;&#29983;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">, Law Offices of Yimin Chen &amp; Flushing</FONT></U>
&#25345;&#26377; <FONT STYLE="font-family: Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">JS Beauty Land Network Technology INC. </FONT>&#20844;&#21496;&#20538;&#26435;
<FONT STYLE="font-family: Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><U>24,300 </U></FONT><U>&#32654;&#37329;</U> &#12290;</FONT></P>

<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B><I>The existing original creditor, Mingsheng
Chen , represented by Law Offices of Yimin Chen &amp; Flushing, holds a claim of USD 24,300 against JS Beauty Land </I></B></FONT><B>Network
Technology INC.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 2.5pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#32463;&#21327;&#21830;&#21407;&#20538;&#26435;&#20154;
<U>&#38472;&#26126;&#29983;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">, Law Offices of Yimin Chen &amp; Flushing</FONT></U>
&#24895;&#24847;&#20197; &#65509;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">1 .00 </FONT>&#20154;&#27665;&#24065;&#30340;&#36716;&#35753;&#20215;&#26684;&#65292;&#25226;&#20840;&#37096;
<FONT STYLE="font-family: Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><U>24, 300</U></FONT><U> &#32654;&#37329; </U>&#20538;&#26435;&#36716;&#35753;&#32473;&#26032;&#30340;&#20538;&#26435;&#20154;
<U>&#26417;&#21916;&#29645; </U>&#12290;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 3.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1.55pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B><I>Through mutual agreement, the original
creditor, Mingsheng Chen , and Law </I></B></FONT><B>Offices of Yimin Chen &amp; Flushing have agreed to transfer the entire claim of
US$24,300 to the new creditor, Xizhen Zhu , at a transfer price of RMB 1.00.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 3.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.15pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#20174;&#21452;&#26041;&#31614;&#23383;&#36716;&#35753;&#23436;&#25104;&#26085;&#24320;&#22987;&#65292;&#21407;&#20538;&#26435;&#20154;
<U>&#38472;&#26126;&#29983;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">, Law Offices of Yimin Chen &amp; Flushing</FONT></U>
&#19981;&#20877;&#25345;&#26377; <FONT STYLE="font-family: Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">JS Beauty Land Network Technology INC. </FONT>&#20844;&#21496;&#20538;&#26435;&#12290;&#26032;&#20538;&#26435;&#20154;<U>&#26417;&#21916;&#29645;</U>&#23558;&#25345;&#26377;
<FONT STYLE="font-family: Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">JS Beauty Land Network Technology INC</FONT> &#20844;&#21496;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Calibri, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">$24,
300 </FONT>&#32654;&#37329;&#20538;&#26435;&#12290;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 1.45pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.2pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B><I>From
the date of completion of the transfer upon signing by both parties, the original creditor, Ming sheng Chen , represented by Law Offices
of Yimin Chen &amp; Flushing, shall no longer hold any claims against JS Beauty Land Network Technology INC., whereas the new creditor,
Xizhen Zhu , shall hold claims amounting to US$24,300 against JS Beauty Land Network Technology INC.</I></B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 2.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt SimSun; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#21407;&#20538;&#26435;&#20154;&#65288;&#20986;&#35753;&#26041;&#65289;&#65306;&#38472;&#26126;&#29983;</FONT></P>
